chunks: He is truly among Our faithful creatures.
ai.seo_question: Who is considered among the faithful servants of God in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited to highlight the virtue of specific prophets or Imams, underscoring that true servitude (ubudiyyah) is defined by steadfast faith. It reinforces the concept that divine favor is contingent upon spiritual purity and adherence to God's commandments, a key theme in understanding the status of the Ahl al-Bayt.
